# zerops_public_port_routing (Resource)

IPv4 or IPv6 public port routing. IPv4 requires a dedicated project IPv4 allocation; shared IPv4 is insufficient. Mutations synchronize all staged port routes in the project; foreign changes are refused unless explicitly forced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deploy declared TCP/UDP backend ports before enabling routing.
# IP_V4 is also supported, but requires an existing dedicated project IPv4
# allocation (zerops_project_dedicated_ipv4); the shared IPv4 flag is insufficient.
resource "zerops_public_port_routing" "app" {
  service_id         = zerops_service.app.id
  public_port        = 20000
  internal_port      = 3000
  protocol           = "tcp"
  public_ip_type     = "IP_V6"
  firewall_policy    = "WHITELIST"
  firewall_ip_ranges = ["2001:db8::/32"]
  force_sync         = false
  depends_on         = [zerops_service_deploy.app]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `internal_port` (Number) Declared backend port.
- `public_port` (Number) Public port, 10–65435 except reserved 80 and 443.
- `service_id` (String) Target service ID. Deploy a declared backend port before creating routing.

### Optional

- `firewall_ip_ranges` (Set of String) Firewall IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDRs. Host addresses are sent as /32 or /128 CIDRs while retaining configured spelling in state. Import has no configured spelling and reads API CIDRs; use canonical CIDRs in configuration for an exact import match. Caller IP is never implicitly added.
- `firewall_policy` (String) Firewall BLACKLIST or WHITELIST policy.
- `force_sync` (Boolean) Override provider routing_force_sync. Null inherits; false refuses foreign staged changes.
- `protocol` (String) Declared backend protocol: tcp or udp.
- `public_ip_type` (String) IP_V6 (default) or IP_V4. IPv4 requires an existing dedicated project IPv4 allocation, not the shared IPv4 flag.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable routing ID.
- `is_synced` (Boolean) Whether the staged rule has been applied. Unsynced owned rules reconcile on apply.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import an existing IPv6 port routing ID. Import never synchronizes staged changes.
terraform import zerops_public_port_routing.app ROUTING_ID
```
